assessments.finding_note: “迷当得礼后出兵五万，攻取南安”将原文中出兵前往南安、尚未明确攻取的行动表述为已经攻取南安。
assessments.reason: Accepted scene adds the unsupported outcome that Mi Dang had already captured Nan'an; the original only says he led troops toward Nan'an.
assessments.required_fix: 将“攻取南安”改为“前往南安”或“进攻南安”，保留原文中尚未明确攻取南安的行动状态。

assessments.finding_note: “迫他率兵解围”略强化了原文中郭淮劝说迷当、迷当同意出兵的自愿程度。
assessments.reason: This is a slight wording intensification, but the accepted scene preserves the same event: Guo Huai persuades Mi Dang, who then leads the troops to relieve the siege.
